title: Hypothetical past
note: would rather + subject + past · it is (high) time + past · as if / as though · suppose / supposing / what if · 4 strands x 12 · 48 items · built to live 2026-08-06 (cloud run 5)

cards.title: A past tense that is not about the past
cards.title_cz: Minulý čas, který není o minulosti
cards.body: Four everyday structures put the verb into the **past simple** while talking about **now** or the **future**. The past tense marks the situation as unreal or unwelcome, not as earlier in time. Step back one further — to the **past perfect** — and you are talking about the real past.
cards.body_cz: Čtyři běžné vazby dávají sloveso do **minulého prostého**, i když mluví o **přítomnosti** nebo **budoucnosti**. Minulý čas tu značí nereálnost nebo nelibost, ne dřívější dobu. Když ustoupíte ještě o krok — do **předminulého času** — mluvíte o skutečné minulosti.

table.caption: The four patterns
rows: what you want them to do
I would rather you did not park here.
He acts as if he were the boss.

cards.title: would rather: one subject or two
cards.title_cz: would rather: jeden podmět, nebo dva
cards.body: With **one** subject it is simply **would rather + base form**. Add a **second** subject and the verb must go into the past simple — this is the half learners forget.
cards.body_cz: S **jedním** podmětem je to prostě **would rather + základní tvar**. Přidejte **druhý** podmět a sloveso musí do minulého prostého — právě na tuhle půlku se zapomíná.
points: I would rather stay at home. (my own preference — base form)
I would rather you stayed at home. (about you — past simple)
I would rather you had not told him. (past perfect — regret about what you did)

cards.title: it is time = a mild complaint
cards.body: **it is time + past simple** says the thing is overdue and somebody is at fault. **it is high time** says the same with more impatience. Compare the neutral **it is time to + base form**, which blames nobody.
cards.body_cz: **it is time + minulý prostý** říká, že se to mělo stát už dávno a někdo za to může. **it is high time** je totéž, jen netrpělivěji. Srovnejte s neutrálním **it is time to + základní tvar**, které nikoho neobviňuje.

table.caption: Blame or no blame
rows: It is time to go home.
It is time we went home.
It is high time he found a job.

cards.title: as if: unreal or possible
cards.body: **as if** and **as though** are interchangeable. Use the **past** when the comparison is untrue, the **past perfect** when it was untrue earlier — but keep a **normal present tense** when the thing might genuinely be so.
cards.body_cz: **as if** a **as though** jsou zaměnitelné. Použijte **minulý čas**, když srovnání není pravdivé, **předminulý**, když nebylo pravdivé dřív — ale nechte **běžný přítomný čas**, když to klidně může být pravda.
points: He acts as if he were the boss. (he is not)
She looked as though she had seen an accident. (she had not)
It looks as if it is going to rain. (it really might — present tense)

table.caption: Avoid / Say
rows: I would rather you don't park here.
I would rather you **did not** park here.
It is time we go home.
It is time that you started.
He acts as if he is the boss.
He acts as if he **were** the boss.
